settings.title: Magnesium Glycinate
settings.text: A highly bioavailable form designed for gentle, fast absorption. Unlike cheaper forms like magnesium oxide, glycinate is bonded to the amino acid glycine, which helps your body absorb it more efficiently and reduces the chance of stomach upset. It's one of the most well-tolerated forms available for nightly use.

settings.title: L-Theanine
settings.text: Naturally found in tea leaves, L-Theanine is often paired with magnesium to help ease a racing mind as you wind down for the night. It supports a calm, relaxed state of mind before bed. Together with magnesium, it supports the kind of calm that makes it easier to fall asleep.

settings.title: Zero Fillers
settings.text: We keep the ingredient list short and purposeful, so you know exactly what you're taking every night. No artificial sweeteners or unnecessary additives — just a clean, effective formula. Nothing is included just to bulk up the label.

settings.title: Third-Party Tested
settings.text: Every batch is tested for purity and potency by an independent third party. This means you can trust that what's on the label matches what's actually in the bottle. It's an extra layer of quality control we build into every batch.

settings.title: Step 1: Take Nightly
settings.text: Take one serving about 30 minutes before bedtime, giving your body time to start settling before you actually lie down. This window allows the formula to begin working as part of your wind-down routine rather than right as you're falling asleep.

settings.title: Step 2: Unwind
settings.text: Pair it with your nightly wind-down routine, whether that's dimming the lights, putting your phone away, or reading for a few minutes. The combination of the supplement and a calming routine works better together than either one alone.

settings.title: Step 3: Stay Consistent
settings.text: Use it nightly for at least 2 weeks to notice the full benefits, since relaxation and sleep quality tend to build gradually rather than change overnight. Skipping nights here and there can make it harder to notice a consistent difference.

settings.heading: When should I take this?
settings.row_content: We recommend taking it in the evening, about 30 minutes before bed, to support relaxation and sleep. Taking it earlier in the day won't cause any harm, but it's specifically formulated to support your nighttime wind-down routine. Building it into a consistent time each night also helps it become an easy habit to stick with.

settings.heading: Will this make me drowsy during the day?
settings.row_content: No, it's formulated to support nighttime relaxation and shouldn't cause daytime drowsiness when taken as directed in the evening. It's not a sedative — it's designed to gently support your body's natural ability to relax and wind down. If you have concerns about how your body responds to new supplements, start with a smaller amount and adjust as needed.

settings.heading: Is this safe to take every night?
settings.row_content: Yes, it's formulated for nightly use as part of a regular routine. It's made without harsh fillers, so it's designed to be gentle enough for consistent, long-term use. As always, consult your doctor first if you have underlying health conditions, are pregnant or nursing, or are taking medications that may interact with magnesium.

settings.heading: How long until I notice a difference?
settings.row_content: Many customers notice improved relaxation within the first week, with fuller benefits building over 2-4 weeks of consistent nightly use. Sleep and relaxation are cumulative — the more consistently you take it, the more noticeable the difference tends to become. We recommend sticking with it nightly for at least a few weeks before evaluating how well it's working for you.

settings.heading: Made For The End Of Your Day

settings.text: Dim the lights, take your dose, and let your body settle into the rest it's been waiting for. It only takes a moment, but it signals to your body that the day is winding down and it's time to relax. Whether you take it with a glass of water or as the last step in your nighttime routine, this small ritual can make falling asleep and staying relaxed feel far less like a struggle.

settings.caption: 01 — Formula
settings.heading: A Form Your Body Recognizes
settings.text: Magnesium Glycinate is one of the most bioavailable forms available, meaning your body can absorb and use it more efficiently than cheaper forms like magnesium oxide. It's gentle on the stomach, which is why it's a common choice for nightly use without the digestive discomfort some other forms cause. We add L-Theanine alongside it to further support a calm, relaxed state of mind as you wind down.

settings.caption: 02 — Routine
settings.heading: Part Of Winding Down
settings.text: There's no need to overhaul your evening — just take it as the last step before bed, whether that's after brushing your teeth or right as you're getting into bed. Because it's such a small addition, it's easy to keep up with every single night. And it's that nightly consistency, more than any single dose, that makes the biggest difference over time.
